caption: This drawing depicts the upper part of a person's head and neck, but the face itself is left blank and uncolored. The most prominent feature is an elaborate hairstyle composed of large, soft curls rendered in light gray tones with fine pencil outlines for definition and subtle shading to suggest volume. Across the top of the head, there is a wide, powder-blue headband that is shaded to indicate its cylindrical shape. The left ear is visible and adorned with a simple, thin gold hoop earring. Below the head, slightly to the right, there is an incomplete outline suggesting a shoulder and neckline, with an additional cluster of curly hair—drawn in a similar style as the main hair—which appears to represent a smaller or partial wig section attached near the neck or shoulder area. The rest of the paper remains uncolored and unshaded, with the drawing composition mostly centered vertically and the objects spaced to clearly distinguish each element.
title: Headdress
